_plan_source: User-supplied floor plan, 14.26 × 7.04 m envelope, 8 rooms with printed dimensions. Each room below carries the actual measurements + opening layout + furniture placement read off the plan, plus a viewpoint chosen to show the room as the plan dictates.

global.tech: architectural interior photography, magazine quality (Dezeen, AD, Wallpaper*), ultra-photoreal, global illumination, soft natural contact shadows, perfectly straight verticals, kodak portra 400 grain, no fisheye

rooms.name: Séjour
rooms.layout: two large windows on the north wall, one window on the east wall, double-door opening on the west wall leading to the hall, no openings on the south wall
rooms.placement: L-shaped low sofa group in the centre facing the north windows, walnut coffee table on a wool rug in front, dining table with 4 chairs along the east wall, slim console along the south wall under a large abstract canvas, tall potted olive tree in the north-west corner near the windows
rooms.viewpoint: view from the south-west corner standing in the doorway, looking north-east diagonally across the room — the sofa group is in mid-ground, the dining area visible at the right, the windows pour daylight from the back-left
rooms.ceiling: matte white plaster, recessed plaster-in downlights on a 2 m grid
rooms.lighting: Isamu Noguchi Akari paper-lantern pendant over the coffee table, linear cove LED 2700K along the ceiling/wall junction, late golden-hour sunlight raking across the floor
rooms.furniture: low-slung modular bouclé sofa in ivory, Noguchi walnut coffee table, Saarinen Tulip dining table in white marble with 4 oak wishbone CH24 chairs, slim oak console
rooms.colors: Farrow & Ball Cornforth White walls, accent in terracotta brûlée throw and dried-olive green
rooms.extra: single large abstract canvas in muted blues on the south wall, dried branches in a monumental stone vessel, two open books on the coffee table

rooms.name: Chambre 1
rooms.layout: two windows on the north wall flooding the room with morning light, door on the east wall leading to the bathroom, door on the south wall to the hall, west wall is full-length built-in wardrobe
rooms.placement: double platform bed centred against the south wall with headboard facing north towards the windows, two slim nightstands flanking, full-height fluted oak wardrobe across the entire west wall, no other furniture (bedroom is intentionally quiet)
rooms.viewpoint: view from the south-east corner near the bathroom door, looking north-west across the bed towards the two north windows and the wardrobe wall on the right
rooms.floor: european white-oak engineered planks, matte oil finish, running east–west
rooms.walls: lime plaster warm white on three walls, fluted oak panelling on the wardrobe (west) wall
rooms.ceiling: matte white, single inset cove LED above the bed headboard
rooms.lighting: twin Articolo Float pendants in alabaster hanging low over each nightstand, soft north-side morning daylight raking across the bedding
rooms.furniture: low oak platform double bed, linen bedding in oat milk + stone grey + deep-forest-green throw, two slim oak nightstands with brass pulls, full-length built-in wardrobe in fluted oak
rooms.colors: warm off-white with woody undertones, forest-green accent
rooms.extra: small framed sumi-e ink print above the headboard, an indoor fig tree in a terracotta pot at the foot of the bed, vintage muted Persian rug under the bed

rooms.name: Salle de bain
rooms.layout: small frosted window high on the north wall above the bathtub, door on the south wall connecting to chambre 1, no other openings
rooms.placement: freestanding bathtub along the full length of the north wall under the window, wall-hung porcelain washbasin on the west wall, wall-hung WC on the east wall, mirror above the basin
rooms.viewpoint: view from the south-east corner standing in the doorway, looking north-west — the bathtub fills the back of the frame under soft daylight from the high window, the basin is on the left
rooms.floor: honed travertine large-format tiles, 60×60, warm putty
rooms.walls: tadelakt polished microcement in warm putty all around, mirror panel above the basin
rooms.lighting: two alabaster wall sconces flanking the mirror, soft diffused daylight through the frosted north window
rooms.furniture: monolithic stone bathtub hand-carved, wall-hung porcelain wash basin, Vola brushed-brass tapware, wall-hung WC with concealed cistern
rooms.colors: warm stone, putty, soft brass — all neutrals
rooms.extra: rolled linen towels stacked on a small teak stool beside the bath, single olive branch in a slim ceramic vase

rooms.name: Chambre 2
rooms.dimensions: small guest bedroom, 3.01 × 3.32 m, 12.4 m², 2.6 m ceiling
rooms.layout: one tall window on the west wall facing the bed, door on the east wall
rooms.placement: ONE single platform bed centred against the back wall, headboard flat against the back wall, ONE small nightstand to the LEFT of the bed only, ONE full-height wardrobe set flush into the side wall — that is all the furniture. Deliberately sparse, this is a quiet guest room, no desk, no chair, no second piece of seating
rooms.viewpoint: view from the doorway looking straight at the back wall — the single bed is centred mid-frame against the back wall, the window is on the left of the bed with sheer linen curtain catching soft daylight
rooms.floor: european white-oak engineered planks running away from camera
rooms.walls: warm white limewash hand-troweled, with a slim vertical raw-oak panel behind the headboard as a feature
rooms.ceiling: matte white plaster with one small flush ceiling lantern
rooms.lighting: single ceiling lantern, soft west daylight diffused by a sheer linen curtain
rooms.furniture: ONE single platform bed in pale solid oak, low ~35 cm tall, simple flat low headboard in matching oak, tailored white linen bedding with a single navy-blue wool throw folded across the foot — ONE small oak nightstand 40 cm wide with one stoneware lamp on top — NO chair, NO desk, NO second bed
rooms.colors: warm white walls, raw oak, navy accent on the throw
rooms.extra: a small framed minimalist line drawing above the headboard, a single monstera plant in a stoneware pot near the window, a wool rug under the bed

rooms.name: Salle d'eau
rooms.dimensions: small wet room, 2.20 × 1.16 m, 2.55 m², 2.6 m ceiling
rooms.layout: no window, door on the north wall connecting to the hall, single ventilation grille
rooms.placement: frameless walk-in shower along the back (south) wall, slim wall-hung porcelain basin on the east wall, small wall-hung WC on the west wall
rooms.viewpoint: view from the doorway looking south straight at the walk-in shower against the back wall, basin on the left edge of the frame
rooms.ceiling: matte white plaster with a single small downlight
rooms.lighting: single alabaster wall sconce above the basin, warm 2700K downlight in the shower
rooms.furniture: frameless walk-in shower with rain head, slim wall-hung porcelain basin, brushed-brass tapware (Vola), wall-hung WC
rooms.extra: single linen hand-towel on a brass hook

rooms.name: Hall
rooms.dimensions: narrow corridor, 4.6 × 2.16 m, 8.76 m², 2.6 m ceiling
rooms.layout: front door at the south end, doors lining both sides — to chambre 2 / salle d'eau on the west, to dressing / changing room on the east, opens to the séjour at the north end
rooms.placement: slim oak console with a stone bowl for keys along the east wall halfway down, tall mirror above the console, simple oak bench along the opposite (west) wall
rooms.viewpoint: axial one-point perspective standing at the south end (front door) looking due north all the way to the séjour at the far end — the corridor recedes symmetrically
rooms.floor: smoked oak chevron parquet running along the length
rooms.ceiling: matte white with a linear cove LED hidden in a plaster reveal along the ceiling edge
rooms.lighting: single warm cove LED at the ceiling line, single wall sconce above the console
rooms.furniture: slim oak console with stone bowl, tall full-height mirror, narrow oak bench with linen cushion
rooms.extra: framed abstract print on the wall, small dried floral arrangement in a stone vase on the console

rooms.name: Dressing
rooms.dimensions: rectangular changing room, 2.35 × 2.34 m, 5.57 m², 2.6 m ceiling
rooms.layout: no window (interior room), door on the east wall opening to the hall, blank walls on the other three sides — designed as a full-height storage room
rooms.placement: full-height oak wardrobes wrapping three walls (south, north, west), bench in the centre
rooms.viewpoint: view from the doorway on the east wall looking west into the room — wardrobes wrap left, right and back, bench centred
rooms.walls: fluted oak panelling on all wardrobe doors, lime plaster on the door wall
rooms.ceiling: matte white, single recessed downlight + linear LED inside the wardrobes
rooms.lighting: single downlight, LED strips inside the wardrobes glowing through the slats
rooms.furniture: wall-to-wall floor-to-ceiling fluted oak wardrobes (three walls), narrow upholstered bench in oat-milk linen in the centre
rooms.colors: warm oak, ivory upholstery, taupe floor
rooms.extra: a folded cashmere throw on the bench, a few books and a small ceramic tray

rooms.name: Cuisine
rooms.dimensions: rectangular galley kitchen, 3.05 × 2.68 m, 8.17 m², 2.6 m ceiling
rooms.layout: window on the east wall above the sink area, opening to the séjour on the north side (no door), built-in along the south wall, fridge in the north-east corner
rooms.placement: L-shaped cabinetry: south wall = oven + stove + counter, east wall = sink under window + counter, refrigerator in the corner where the two walls meet, no island (galley shape)
rooms.viewpoint: view from the opening on the north side, standing where the séjour ends, looking south into the kitchen — the L-shaped run wraps left and ahead, the window on the left lets in morning light
rooms.walls: handle-less matte lacquer cabinetry in sage green on the lower run, full-height stone backsplash (taj mahal quartzite, honed) on the south wall
rooms.ceiling: matte white plaster with a single linear tube pendant over the worktop, two recessed downlights
rooms.lighting: single linear tube pendant over the worktop, recessed downlights, soft east-side morning daylight through the window
rooms.furniture: L-shaped countertop in honed quartzite, integrated stainless-steel sink under the east window, La Cornue range on the south wall, full-height oak veneer pantry in the corner, integrated panel-front refrigerator
rooms.colors: sage green cabinetry, taupe stone floor, warm oak, brass tapware
rooms.extra: a bowl of lemons on the worktop, fresh herbs in small ceramic pots on the window ledge, no bar stools (galley)
